text.line: We would monitor the impacts of this policy over the initial years following implementation.
The department would proactively monitor the impact of the scheme, in terms of costs, and behavioural changes, from the point of implementation.

It is considered that given the length of criminal proceedings, and the time lag of any changes to work their way through the system, we expect no impacts would be witnessed for at least 18 months from the point of implementation.
However, the department would proactively monitor trends and feedback from users throughout this period to determine how this reform is working in practice.
